sourceCopy.name: Moon Phase Calculator
sourceCopy.title: Moon Phase Calculator: Free Lunar Calendar | UsefulVerse
sourceCopy.description: Estimate the Moon phase, illuminated fraction and primary phase dates for a month. Free calculation in your browser, with no account.
sourceCopy.intro: Choose a date to estimate the Moon’s phase and illumination, then see the approximate new moon, quarter and full moon moments for that UTC month.
sourceCopy.howQuestion: How do I check the Moon phase for a date?
sourceCopy.howAnswer: Choose a date from 1900 through 2100 and calculate. The page estimates the phase, approximate illuminated percentage and primary phase moments for that calendar month.
sourceCopy.privacyAnswer: No. The calculation runs in this browser. It does not use your location, call an astronomy service or save your date.

fields.methodNote: Uses a mean synodic cycle anchored to a reference new moon, not a full astronomical ephemeris. Individual phase times can differ by hours and the displayed UTC date can differ from a local calendar date. This global phase estimate does not calculate local moonrise, moonset, visibility, or religious calendar dates.
fields.privacyNote: No location permission, upload, account, API or automatic saving.

messages.invalid: Choose a valid date from 1900 through 2100.

additionalFaqs.question: Are the phase times exact?
additionalFaqs.answer: No. This lightweight tool uses a mean lunar cycle. Actual primary phase times can differ by several hours, so do not use it as an ephemeris or for time-critical observation.

additionalFaqs.question: Does the Moon phase depend on my location?
additionalFaqs.answer: The geocentric phase is broadly the same worldwide at a given instant. Local moonrise, moonset, visibility and the local calendar date depend on location and are not calculated here.

additionalFaqs.question: Does this show religious lunar dates?
additionalFaqs.answer: No. It does not predict crescent visibility or determine the beginning of a religious month. Follow the relevant local authority or calendar.
